description: MEDAS Notary admin addresses (docs/notary-spec.md 16.5). The git history of this file is the record of who was an admin when. Entries are never removed: an admin who leaves gets valid_until. An approve or revoke transaction counts only if its sender is an admin with role 'admin' at the block time of the transaction (valid_from <= time < valid_until).

admins.note: public localnet test key (localnet/admin.mnemonic); never valid on another network
